book.name: Ka Teke Pangwa
book.title: KA TEKE PANGWA Ka i Yesus Krais dipene ende Jon tongwa

content: God dem kumbrukwa dis 7 mina suna yeingwa i toindi endingwa
Ana na pirka God holi yungumo mina ka binan bogl ta di angelo 7 wagle tongwa, “Ene endpi God dem kumbrukwa dis mina suna yeingwa i toindi makandle endiyo.”

Yegl dungo angelo namba 1 endpi ana ye dismo toindi makandle endungwa. Yegl orko yomba ye kambu are munomo igo pangwa ya kuiyamo dembiye karaugl ereteingwa yomba ye nangino mina moi kinde giu orkwa kane kane nongwa.
Te angelo namba 2 dismo toindi mundi nigl endungwa. Ana mundi nigl wu yomba geglkwa bormaino koglkwa mereyegl ongwa. Ana nigle taragl kor-meglkwa prapra gogl kondingwa.
Te angelo namba 3 dismo toindi nigl kande ya kembra prapra mina endungo ana ye wu bormai eingwa.
Ana angelo ta nigl prapra sugl moglkwa ye yegl dungo na pirka:

content.text: ikra pre ene topono kinde i

content: Ana alta mina ka yegl dungo pirka:
Angelo namba 4 ye dismo toindi ande mina endungwa. God kanwinge orko ande pond dongo ana ninga dumara i yomba de tenge erikwa.

Yomba ande detenge ertre ana God i yombuglomo pai kuno orko taragl prapra sugl moglkwa i yeglmere orkwa i yomba mambuno kinde kangiye mangagl singwa. Taragl kinde yeglmere orkwa i God yombuglomo pai kuno orko erambuka. Ba yomba mambuno kinde erikwa i kondo nomano yake tekre te God kangiye di mitna ende tekrikwa.

Ana angelo namba 5 dismo toindi kambu are sia kingmo mina endungwa. Endungo kambu are yombuglomo mina yomba atne meglmara igle mim waidi kondungwa. Te ye giugl pond geglkwa ipre drambino giugl kaiglkwa.
Ye giu geglkwa ya moi kanekane neingwa ipre deno pond kumbro mangaglsi God heven nem teingwa. Yegl ere ye mambuno kinde erikwa i kondokre nomano yake tekrikwa.
Te angelo namba 6 dismo toindi nigl kande Yufretis mina endungwa. Niglmo darukwa, i ande umara ire king wagle unaglkwa pre konbauna akekun ere yongwa.
Ana na kaniga spirit kinde suwota ye koglko mereyegl meglkwa, ye toki kande dragon ya kambu are ya te propet kakimbi drano mina ende menda wingwa.
Ye spirit kinde spiritmo wagle kimagl kanekane erikwa, ye ende makan koglkoglo pi king meglmara dimakai simbi ana God yombuglomo kande pangwa engemo kande mina kunda eraglkwa.
“Piryo! Na kunogl gogl yomba mereyegl unaglkwa!
Yomba ta ugl paikre, gaglmo ende ana akekun eremoglkwa, ye gun yeiyondo. Sraglpre, ye nangiye yokoko moglkrukwa pre yomba meglmara ye wu ikine ikine enambuka, ye angai goglkrambuka.”
Ana spirit kinde wagle eremogl king wagle dimakai singwa, dumomo i Hibru kanno mina Amagedon
we dingwa.
Ana angelo namba 7 ye dismo toindi kamun mitna wau yomara endungwa. Te God holi yungumo yungugl kra sia king yomara ka kande ta dungwa, “Taragl i ere dundungwa!”
Ana kamun potndi poriya sungo, wiyau endigo ongo, kamun gurgagla kande dungo, ana imem pond kaima okuna makandle ta ungo yomba ta kankrimere imem i ungwa.

Yegl ere siti kande sibukondi suwota endungwa, te siti makan koglkoglo yongwa yange deruwagl erikwa. Ana God pir ikine dumo kande Babilon ende ana ye dem kumbrukwa wainmo kap mina moglkwa i tongo neingwa.
Te ailan prapra teke ende taya eingo, makan muglo prapra ta paikrikwa.

Te kamkua mina kamun araglmongo pond goriye suwarandi yumbunmo 50 kilogram, ana yange yomba angaino mina si kinde kaima eretongwa. God araglmongo endungwa ipre ye God mangagl si teingwa. Sraglpre, God dem kumbrukwa i wu kinde kaima ongwa.

footnotes.text: Propet kimbi i kambu are namba 2 iwe. Ye kambu are namba wan propetmo mereyegl moglkwa ana ye eremogl kambu are namba 1 i kuiyamo yomba prapra dembiye karaugl ere teiyo dungwa. Ka Teke Pangwa 13:11-16 mina kano.
Epigl 15 mina ka pangwa i, Yesus Krais yene ka dungwa.

Amagedon i yegl, “Megido kamun muglo.” Okuna yomba epigl ta eremogl, Israel kunda bogl tendre ana King Josaia sigeglkwa, i taun Megido mangigl kaima sigeglkwa. Ka tau 2 King 23:29-30 ya te 2 Stori 35:20-24 mina kano. Yeglpre, nomano pai pogl sungwa yomba tau eremogl kamun Megido ipre ta dikrumedi pirkwa. Ana okuwo kimbirnem wagle dumo ta pindre ana wu kinde pi ana wau bogl kondinaglkwa ipre ka diboglme dingwa.
